exercises.name: SQUAT TO STALDER
exercises.description: Follow the video to do a stalder squat. The goal is to be able to hold the position while lifting one leg at a time (then eventually both feet), but to begin you may need to focus on squatting and weight bearing through your arms.

exercises.name: STALDER PULSES
exercises.description: Start this move in a straddle with your arms behind your legs. Point your toes and stalder lift both legs up at the same time. Hold that contraction and use your arms and core maintain legs up and pulse

exercises.name: FROG HOLD
exercises.goal: 3 reps for as long as you can hold, max of 1 minute per frog
exercises.description: This move starts by placing your hands on the ground flat in front of you slightly wider than your shoulders. You will then bring your feet close to your hands to allow your inner thigh near your knees to lean against your elbows. From there you will lean forward to lessen weight on your feet until you can lift BOTH FEET up off the ground.

exercises.name: HANDSTAND WALL WALK UPS
exercises.description: This move starts in a tall plank position with your feet close to the wall. As you walk your hands backwards towards the wall, walk your feet up the wall. Use your core to keep your lower back from arching.

exercises.name: BRIDGE ON WALL FOR SHOULDERS
exercises.description: Push up into a bridge with your feet on the wall. Weight shift onto your hands while pushing your chest up to the ceiling to work on opening your shoulders. WALK YOUR FEET BACK DOWN TO BRIDGE TO GET OUT

exercises.name: SPLIT STRETCH
exercises.goal: 30 sec holds x 2 reps each side
exercises.description: Begin in a kneeling position then extend one leg out in front of you. Lower your hands to the floor on either side of you then slow slide your front leg out in front of you in a front split.

exercises.name: PANCAKE STRETCH
exercises.description: Sit in a middle straddle with your legs as far apart as you can with your toes pointed up. Keep your back straight and arms to your ears. Hip hinge forward to feel a stretch.

exercises.name: DRAGON TAILS
exercises.description: Start by inverting your body holding onto a bar or the underside of a couch/bed. Then lower your body keeping your core active to lessen any hip bending. You then will lift your body back up to an inverted position. **You can allow your knees to bend and touch the floor if you cannot lower and return to inverted position without.

exercises.name: TUCK HOP TO HANDSTAND AND NEGATIVE
exercises.description: Begin in a tucked position with feet together and hands on the ground. Using both feet, you shift your weight into your hands and hop aiming to get your hips stacked over your shoulders and then extend to handstand. Slowly lower back to the ground in reverse as shown in the video.

exercises.name: Cable Leaning Step-Up
exercises.description: Lean slightly into the cable stack for a glute stretch at the bottom. Step up through your heel, squeezing at the top.

exercises.name: GHR — Rounded Back, Hip Thrust at Top
exercises.description: Glute-ham raise with a rounded back. At the top of each rep, thrust your hips forward for a full glute contraction.

exercises.name: Hip Abductor Machine
exercises.description: Sit upright, push knees apart against the pads. Squeeze at the end range, control the return.

exercises.name: Ab Wheel Rollout
exercises.description: From kneeling, roll out as far as you can control. Keep your core braced and hips extended — don't let your back sag.

exercises.name: Barbell Hip Thrust
exercises.description: Back against a bench, barbell across your hips. Drive through heels, squeeze glutes hard at the top. Go heavy.

exercises.name: Reverse Hyper
exercises.description: Lie face-down on the pad, swing legs up using glutes and hamstrings. Control the descent.

exercises.name: Cable Kickback
exercises.description: Ankle strap on the low cable. Drive your heel straight back, squeezing your glute at the top. Don't arch your back.

exercises.name: Kneeling Cable Crunch
exercises.description: Kneel in front of a high cable. Crunch down by flexing your abs, pulling your elbows toward your knees. Don't pull with your arms.

exercises.name: Deficit Reverse Lunge
exercises.description: Stand on a 25-lb plate. Step back into a reverse lunge, sinking deep for a glute stretch. Drive up through the front heel.

exercises.name: Frog Thrust
exercises.description: Feet together in a frog position, thrust your hips up squeezing your glutes at the top.

exercises.name: Hip Abductor Machine + Banded Lateral Walks
exercises.description: Superset: hip abductor machine for 20 reps, then immediately do banded lateral walks 20 steps each direction.

exercises.name: Weighted Decline Sit-Up
exercises.description: On a decline bench, hold a weight plate at your chest. Crunch up under control and lower slowly — don't let your back slam down.
